audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty text was gender-wrong throughout (Mel is she/her) and the level chart disagreed with itself: full phases[0].side/phases[1].side said 'Mel' while content win[0]/win[1] said 'Skill', and phases[4]/phases[5] said 'Skill' while win[4]/win[5] said 'Malzahar'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Malzahar/Malzahar/Skill and matches the content layer; the full layer was stale. 55.43% over 2699 games supports Malzahar owning the 6 and first-item windows.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and phases[1].side -> Skill (whys rewritten to match); phases[4].side and phases[5].side -> Malzahar (win[4]/win[5] already read Malzahar, so no paired content edit — a no-op would be rejected).

audit.why: Spikes are accurate: Lost Chapter shove engine, level 6 Nether Grasp on a dashless target, Liandry's, then a re-even late as Golden Eclipse and Overwhelm execute scale. Mel's own spike is Rebuttal rank-up (38s at rank 1 down to 26s at rank 5) making her burst window nearly permanent.
audit.corrected: Left spikes[0..2] alone; corrected spikes[3] which called Golden Eclipse 'Solar Snare (R)'.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named a non-existent ability 'Iron Boundary' for Malzahar's passive and contained no digit at all. spikes[3] called Golden Eclipse 'Solar Snare (R)'. The decisive interactions — Rebuttal reflecting Malzahar's projectile Q, Mel having no dash against a 700-range point-and-click suppression, and Rebuttal's terrain cutting a dashless Malzahar's retreat — were never stated with numbers.
audit.why: Malzahar's passive is Void Shift (damage reduction + CC immunity), not a spell shield named Iron Boundary. Riot's Rebuttal text: 'reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage'. Malzahar Q carries the projectile flag; Mel's kit has no dash. Golden Eclipse is R; Solar Snare is E (11/10.5/10/9.5/9s).
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries Rebuttal 38s->26s, Solar Snare 11s->9s and Nether Grasp 140/110/80s, and the fabricated name is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two dosFull/dontsFull bodies were the tradeGood and tradeBad strings pasted verbatim under unrelated titles, and 12 fields called Mel 'he/his/him'.
audit.why: lintFindings COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; MISGENDER across tldr, tradeGood, tradeBad, phases[1..3].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, dosFull[1], dosFull[2].t, dontsFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[0].t, report[3].t, report[4].t, report[9].t.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to match their titles from Mel's kit; pronouns corrected.

edits.before: His combo through a broken shield kills you — so the shield is the matchup. Guard it like a third summoner.
edits.after: Her combo through a broken Void Shift kills you — so your shield is the matchup. Guard it like a third summoner.

edits.before: Mel wins by landing Rebuttal, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Mel wins by stacking Overwhelm off Radiant Volley, then cashing it with Golden Eclipse from any range.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Trading into her with Void Shift down — Overwhelm stacks infinitely and Golden Eclipse cashes them from anywhere on the map.

Whether Malzahar's Void Shift CC immunity blocks Solar Snare's root outright or only while unbroken — kit text says CC immunity lingering after damage, but the exact break rule is not in Riot's description.
